result.topic_en: Computation for p = 41 of a quartic (biquadratic) character sum of the 41st roots of unity, indexed by powers of the primitive root 6, with i = 9 (a square root of −1 mod 41) and 41 = 5² + 4² (5+4i); the right side tabulates residues with signs.

methods.what: Quartic character (Gauss-type) sum T over the 41st roots of unity r, with terms ordered by successive powers of the primitive root 6 mod 41 and coefficients cycling 1, i, −1, −i
Analogous sum U starting from r^17, and the relation between U and T
Decomposition 41 = 5² + 4² as the Gaussian integer 5+4i, with i represented by 9 mod 41 (9² ≡ −1)
Tables of residues mod 41 with assigned signs (classification of residues for the character computation)
